column_description: A CHAR(12) primary key uniquely identifying each session behavior record (e.g., 'SE1234567890').
An enum (LoginTimePattern_enum) describing login times (Burst, Bot-like, Random, Regular).
An enum (LoginFrequency_enum) labeling login frequency (Medium, High, Low, Suspicious).
NUMERIC(4,1) measuring variance in login locations (e.g., '2.7').
NUMERIC(4,2) measuring how regularly the user logs in (e.g., '0.75').
A JSONB structure capturing session activity distribution (e.g., '{"morning": 30, "night": 70}').
